title: Private deploy launch: release-notes orchestration, enablement artifacts, and cross-team sync for RBAC/Audit/KMS
creator: Lena Park
description: Coordinated launch checklist and delivery plan for Private/VPC/on-prem features focused on RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integration. Goal: produce a single-source release notes bundle, operator runbook, and enablement kit so GTM, Support, and Customer Success can execute zero-friction activations for enterprise customers. This ticket centralizes ownership of the communications artifacts, handoff points for engineering and design, and the final sign-off path with Legal/Compliance.
tasks: Draft consolidated release-notes markdown that include upgrade steps, breaking changes, and known limitations
Create operator runbook: preflight checklist, canary rollout steps, rollback procedures, and SLO/telemetry dashboards links
Assemble enablement kit: enablement slide deck, quick start scripts, sample IAM templates, and troubleshooting playbook
Coordinate with Eng to validate exact KMS key rotation flow and required IAM scopes for RBAC roles
Sync with Design to produce updated Console screenshots, RBAC role mapping UI copy, and audit-log viewer examples
Collect legal/compliance blurbs and retention policy language; confirm audit log PII guidance
Review release-notes draft with Support and Solutions Engineers; iterate based on feedback
Publish release bundle to Drive and mark release-notes PR for docs repo; schedule announcement cadence
acceptance_criteria: Release notes finalized and approved by Eng, Design, and Legal
Operator runbook published and validated by SRE and Support with at least one dry-run checklist completed
Enablement kit available in shared Drive with clearly versioned artifacts and links to dashboards
Staged release notes PR merged into docs repo and tagged for private-2025.03
Stakeholder sync completed and email+in-product banner templates staged for announcement
